subject: Partner-led discovery: Redwood x CloudNova \u2014 next steps & demo schedule
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@cloudnova.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 14:03:00 +0000
Subject: Partner-led discovery: Redwood x CloudNova — next steps & demo schedule

Hi Alex — great to meet you and the CloudNova team on today's intro call. Thanks for walking through the marketplace integration goals and the use cases you see (marketplace listing + managed services for enterprise customers).

Recap / what we heard:
- Primary ask: embed Redwood inference as a marketplace offering and enable private deployments for regulated customers.
- Success metrics: <20% increase in time-to-onboard for marketplace customers, clear pricing bands for Dedicated capacity.
- Constraints: procurement / security questionnaire will be needed (SOC2 + KMS integration).

Next steps we proposed on the call:
1) Redwood technical deep-dive + demo (45–60m) — include our SE to map architecture and deployment options
2) Share a mutual action plan + initial pricing bands
3) CloudNova to share any standard marketplace integration docs / procurement timeline

Can we lock in a time next week for the technical deep-dive? Rafael (cc'd) will run the demo and focus on private deployment options and Dedicated sizing. Below are some windows we have next week (all in US PDT):
- Tue 2026-04-14: 09:00–10:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Wed 2026-04-15: 11:00–12:00
- Thu 2026-04-16: 08:30–09:30 or 16:00–17:00

If those don't work, feel free to propose two times and I'll confirm. I've attached a short mutual action plan and our intro deck for context.

Thanks — excited to move this forward with CloudNova and Camila.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: CloudNova_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf, RDW_IntroDeck.pdf
